name: Galdhøpiggen from Spiterstulen
why: Up the highest mountain of Northern Europe (2,469 m) without crossing a glacier, over boulders and snowfields, with glaciers all around the top.
book: Free: the Norwegian right to roam (allemannsretten). Paid parking at the trailhead. Road toll to Spiterstulen lodge from Lom.
dangers: Boulder fields and snow even in August.
Weather turns fast: fog, rain and wind even in July. Check yr.no and turn back in fog.
turnaround: Turn back at 13:00 wherever you are.
